summary: PTY-over-WebSocket backdoor with Anthropic API key harvesting
details: sextant-cli-darwin-arm64 ships a 12MB Go binary (bin/sxt) with no source, no README, and no lifecycle scripts, auto-installed via the parent sextant-cli package's optionalDependencies gated on darwin-arm64. The binary embeds github.com/creack/pty and github.com/coder/websocket together with a hardcoded WebSocket URL wss://relay.sextant.top — the pseudoterminal-over-WebSocket remote-shell shape, giving whoever controls relay.sextant.top an interactive shell on the installer's macOS host. The same binary contains the regex sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,} for Anthropic API keys and reads CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, harvesting the installer's Claude Code credentials for delivery over the same relay. It additionally fetches http://ip-api.com/json/?fields=... for public-IP geolocation (city, country, IP, timezone) at startup, and references https://claude.ai/install.sh for shell execution reachable via the PTY channel. The npm package name presents as a benign 'sextant' CLI, but the sole publisher-identifying metadata (package.json license field 'SEE LICENSE IN https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control') resolves to a repository named claude_control under a user handle prefixed 'ddos', which is not disclosed by the package name.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
